title: The emergence of rapid oscillations in a fifth-order KdV equation
summary: We consider the emergence of rapidly propagating, exponentially small-amplitude oscillations in the impulsively started fifth-order Korteweg--de Vries equation (KdV5), and demonstrate that these waves originate due to Stokes' phenomenon in a small-time boundary layer. We rescale the problem in time and construct an auxiliary linear PDE (lKdV5) that reproduces the relevant exponential asymptotic structure, and proceed by two main methods.
